info.title: crab-shell-proxy agent
info.description: OpenAI-compatible chat surface for a per-(agent,user) container behind the mycelium gateway. Each mycelium service that proxies crab-shell-proxy exposes these operations as a discoverable tool (mycelium fetches this document from openapiPath). The operations mycelium surfaces are those whose path also matches a registered route for that service.

post.description: Send an OpenAI-compatible chat completion to this agent and receive its reply. The agent's model is pinned server-side. Set stream=true for a Server-Sent Events stream of chat.completion.chunk deltas.

model.description: Optional model id. Ignored for pinned agents (the server-configured model is used).

messages.description: The conversation so far. The last user message is the turn to answer.

stream.description: When true, the reply streams as SSE chat.completion.chunk events.

200.description: The assistant reply: an OpenAI chat.completion object, or (when stream=true) an SSE stream of chat.completion.chunk events terminated by data: [DONE].

get.description: Returns the OpenAI-compatible model list advertised by this agent.
